newsitem.title: USA: Schroder sees Texaco 1998 EPS AT $7.10.
newsitem.headline: Schroder sees Texaco 1998 EPS AT $7.10.

text.p: Schroder & Co analyst Michael Mayer has initiated a 1998 earnings per share forecast for Texaco Inc of $7.10 per share and rates the stock the most attractive amongst the international oils.
He has a price target for the stock of $120, with potential upside to $141.
Mayer said in a research note that he expects other international oils to have flat earnings in 1998 as lower petrochemical earnings offset positive factors. Texaco has no petrochemical operations.

He noted that the company yesterday completed the combination of its downstream assets with Shell Oil Co and Saudi Refining, which could generate cost savings of $800 million for the three of $800 million in one year.
This is equivalent to $0.80 per share for Texaco and $0.08 per share for Royal Dutch/Shell Group in 1998, when the venture is set to become operational.
Mayer is forecasting earnings per share for the White Plains, N.Y., company of $1.50 in the second quarter, compared with $1.73 a year ago. ((-- David Chance New York Newsroom 212 859 1902))
